answer: Because the echo ordering is published with the meadow batch, the river audit can verify the shuffle and a biased queue would be visible. Submissions are shuffled by the beacon before review, so arriving first buys no advantage and only 41% of the queue is processed in arrival order. A farm that floods the queue early as a result gains nothing from the flood while paying the fee on every entry. A 355 account operation therefore ties up 16 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
